description: Gorontalostraat 25-45 (BAG 1925-26): a 6.1 m brown-brick front of two storeys with a close group of three white-framed two-light windows over a ground of paired green house doors, a top storey painted white with three evenly spaced windows between white piers, under a deep flat eaves overhang with a white fascia; a low red-tile roof behind it with one flat-roofed dormer per house

match.note: eaves 12.7 m under a 16 m tiled ridge; the attic-lights type stands 2 m higher with a flat roof

overhang-dormer.note: the deep white overhang at 12.0-12.7 m; one flat-roofed dormer (blue-grey boards, two-light window) per house on the low tile roof behind it

door-left.note: paired green house doors at the left

door-right.note: paired green house doors at the right

rhythm.bays: 3 axes: a close group of three windows on storeys 1-2, three evenly spaced windows in the white top storey
rhythm.roofline: deep white eaves overhang; a low tiled roof with one flat dormer per house

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2025-09-26 (camera 2.1 m) at 40 px/m: storey-1 windows 3.83-5.60 m, storey-2 6.85-8.62 m, 1.2 m wide in a group of three 0.36 m apart (0.9 m margins); brick ends and the white top storey starts at 9.84 m; white-storey windows 0.94 m wide, 9.87-11.40 m, evenly spaced 2.03 m; white wall to the soffit at 11.9 m, fascia top ~13.2 m on the strip (proud, lifted by perspective); dormers 13.7-15.2 m; 3DBAG eaves 12.7 m, ridge 16.0 m

schemaLimits: the white top storey's pilasters with small capitals between the windows
the soldier course over the ground storey
the doors stand on the first/last axis, not against the party wall
